review_method: All 57 capture frames were visually inspected in six contact sheets; the previously failing dense D39 and D40 frames were additionally inspected at full 1280x800 resolution after repair.

dense_repair_verification.D39: PASS — title, history controls, map/world panes, requirements focus/scroll affordance, causal panel, input hint and bottom status are all inside the 1280x800 frame.
dense_repair_verification.D40: PASS — the prior vertical overflow is removed; dense requirements are bounded to a focusable semantic-scroll region with an explicit D-pad/arrow affordance while all critical fixed controls and status remain inside the frame.

interaction_acquisition.note: Automated interaction acquisition is runtime evidence only; it is not a human accessibility review and not Steam Deck hardware evidence.

remaining_e7_evidence: any human accessibility observations required by the empirical protocol
notes: This review supersedes only the repaired deck_controller_max_ui capture presentation class. It does not fabricate hardware or human outcomes and does not make E7 PASS.
